definitions.latest: Publishedの新しい順。Published同値はFirst Seenの新しい順。
definitions.hottest: 直近30日Publishedの記事を現在Heatの高い順。
definitions.rising: Heat履歴2点以上・6時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、直近24時間のHeat上昇率で算出。
definitions.persistent_hot: Heat履歴3点以上・48時間以上のspanが揃った記事を対象に、各時点で上位10%を80%以上維持した記事。

latest.title: Private repos still leak secrets to Gheist, a stolen GitHub token campaign
latest.summary_excerpt: Wiz Research has recovered more than 13,500 planted branches from 850+ compromised GitHub accounts, the work of a campaign it calls Gheist, after the user agent the tool sends with its GitHub API requests. The tool takes a stolen token, finds every repository that token can open, and plants a workflow in each one. The workflow prints the repository’s secrets into a log, and the attacker downloads it. The exposure is in private repositories. A … More → The post Private repos still leak secrets to Gheist, a stolen GitHub token campaign appeared first on Help Net Security .
